name: player_set_auto_turn_target_dir_from_world_point
description: Player::SetAutoTurnTargetDirFromWorldPoint derives and stores the normalized X/Z direction from the player's world position to a target point, then enables auto-turn.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x42bab0 validates saveState->playerState loading, target minus worldPos delta calculation, forced zero Y component, zMath::Vec3NormalizeXZ call, autoTurnTargetDir x/y/z stores, and autoTurnActive = 1.
The native smoke verifies that a 3-4-5 X/Z target delta stores a normalized 0.6/0/0.8 direction and enables auto-turn.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x42bab0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player camera/control source-cluster pass.
